purpose: Teach: すてき/好ん/呟い/見失っ/うまかっ/脱ぎ/日当たり/当っ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの新しいお店、すてきよ
lines.en: Sho, the new shop is really lovely.
lines.style: Warm, inviting opening. Gentle lift on the compliment. Speaking to him like she's letting him in on something she's proud of. Unhurried, affectionate.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お野菜の中でトマトを好んで食べるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really like eating tomatoes best out of all the vegetables.
lines.style: Bright, earnest announcement. Quick delivery, eager to share this fact with her. Small-voiced confidence — he's telling her something he thinks matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「がんばれ」って呟いてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying "you've got this" earlier.
lines.style: Soft, knowing tone. Not explaining — just passing along something he might have missed. Slight smile underneath. She's giving him something without making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達を公園で見失ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I lost track of my friend at the park.
lines.style: Quiet admission. Not asking for help — just telling her. Small worry underneath, but matter-of-fact. The way a kid reports something he's been turning over in his head.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんのお味噌汁、本当にうまかったわね
lines.en: Sho, your mom's miso soup was really delicious.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, warmth spreading through the sentence. Not flattering — observing. The tone of someone who noticed and is sharing the observation with him like a small gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お風呂上りに服を脱ぎ捨てちゃダメだよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, I shouldn't throw my clothes on the floor after bath time, right?
lines.style: Careful reasoning out loud. Not asking permission — checking his own understanding. Slight hesitation, like he's testing the logic. Seeking confirmation, not permission.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、日当たり最高よ
lines.en: Sho, the shop has the most wonderful sunlight.
lines.style: Bright, pleased delivery. Emphasis on how well the light comes in. Speaking from genuine satisfaction. The tone of someone who sees a good thing and wants to point it out to someone she likes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのくじが当ったよ
lines.style: Excited, bright announcement. Quick, alive delivery — this is news. The joy of telling her first. Small-voiced but carrying genuine delight, waiting for her to celebrate with him.
